ruling.recommended_action: Route to RydeHELP human review: pull trip telemetry (speed/acceleration trace, harsh-braking and shoulder-use events) for Jurong East MRT → NUS on the disputed trip; take a written account from both parties; point the driver to the Code of Conduct and the reporting paths (driver must not take matters into his own hands); keep the fixed fare of $21.04 unchanged pending review.
ruling.escalation_reason: Rider filed a safety dispute alleging speeding, hard braking and overtaking on the shoulder, and that she felt scared; a dangerous-driving allegation requires human review and cannot be settled on this record, which holds no driving telemetry and no relevant chat content [F6][F3][F4][F5][F1][F2][SAFE-1][SAFE-2].

rejected_claims.reason: The rider advocate requested no_action, but the record does not settle the dangerous-driving allegation: the trace classifies the case as a safety incident requiring human review, and the ride measurements (actual 8.5 km vs optimal 8.6 km; 12.8 min vs 14 min estimate) can neither confirm nor exclude speeding or harsh braking [F1][F2][SAFE-2].

The driver advocate requested no_action, but the driver's post-trip statement 'I drove normally' is a bare denial outside the chat and is not corroborated by any system record of driving behaviour, so it cannot dispose of a safety allegation on its own [F6][SAFE-2].

To the extent the driver relies on the rider never complaining and being on the phone throughout, the absence of an in-ride complaint does not rebut an allegation of dangerous driving; the chat contains only pick-up messages and is silent on the driving [F3][F4][F5][F6][SAFE-2].
